channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Masood Azhar's bounty hike: Is Pakistan's FATF move merely symbolic? Expert weighs in
item.description: Pakistan named Masood Azhar in its 2026 most-wanted list and raised his bounty to PKR 70 lakh, days ahead of October's FATF plenary. Experts call it a familiar compliance signal, noting India will judge Pakistan on verifiable action, not announcements, ahead of a possible grey-list review.

item.title: ‘I am safe now’: Keralite vlogger, who claimed arrest by Mujahideen, says she escaped arrest threat in Afghanistan
item.description: “According to the law of this country, a woman cannot travel alone,” ‘Backpacker Arunima’ said

item.title: Who is Umar Kremlev? Russian businessman and a Putin aide who partially funded Trump Jr's wedding: All you need to know
item.description: Donald Trump Jr's wife, Bettina Anderson, confirmed that Russian businessman Umar Kremlev partially funded their May wedding in the Bahamas. Kremlev has reported ties to Vladimir Putin. Here's all you need to know about him

item.title: Gurugram hit-and-run case: Biker Sia breaks silence asks, ‘Why is police not arresting him?’
item.description: Two days after a viral video showed a car allegedly hitting a two-wheeler rider on Gurugram’s Golf Course Road, biker Sia has questioned why the accused has not yet been arrested. She alleged that the driver is speaking to news channels while still remaining free.

item.title: MHA calls meeting after 3 Italian passengers bypassed immigration at Delhi airport: What we know
item.description: MHA has called an emergency meeting after three Italian passengers allegedly boarded a Lufthansa flight to Munich without completing mandatory immigration at Delhi airport. Air India was issued a show-cause notice over the incident.

item.title: Malaysia Said to Seize Another Three Containers Bound for Israel
item.description: Authorities in Malaysia have seized several more Israel-bound shipments at one of the country’s biggest ports, according to people familiar with the matter, an apparently new level of scrutiny in a nation where anti-Israeli sentiment runs high.

item.title: Oracle Layoffs: Employee says Slack access vanished at 4 am, Reddit post captures fear of AI era cuts
item.description: Two Oracle employees have taken to Reddit to describe how they discovered their access had been cut during the latest round of layoffs, with one saying Slack stopped working at 4 am and another reporting deactivation at 5:45 am.

item.title: ‘Very high salary is a trap’: MBA professional pitches ₹1.5–2 lakh per month as the ideal urban benchmark
item.description: The MBA graduate argued that once an urban professional earns between ₹1.5 lakh and ₹2 lakh per month, the chase for higher earnings can become a trap that erodes family life and well-being.

item.title: Kamala Harris vs Gavin Newsom in 2028? Here's what California Governor said about his presidential bid
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom on Monday (local time) said that he is considering making a run for the US presidency in 2028, but listed a few reasons why he might not go ahead with it.

item.title: Emmy 2026: Alan Cumming urges Americans to vote as he makes National Voter Registration Day plea
item.description: Alan Cumming used his Emmy Awards 2026 acceptance speech to urge Americans to register to vote, reminding viewers that National Voter Registration Day falls on 15 September.

item.title: US Supreme Court rejects Trump bid to restrict mail ballots ahead of November midterm elections
item.description: The US Supreme Court rejected Donald Trump's bid to restrict mail ballots ahead of the midterm elections, allowing states to continue existing voting processes. Two justices dissented, while Trump's proposed rules remain blocked.

item.title: CGHS maps domestic manufacturing capacity for 153 critical drugs to shorten supply delays
item.description: In order to speed up drug procurement, CGHS has directed pharmaceutical manufacturers and authorized importers to submit regulatory and production filings for oncology, diabetes, spinal muscular atrophy therapy and bispecific antibody drugs.

item.title: The Hip Side of Japan the Tourists Havent Figured Out Yet
item.description: The coolest hotels and bars are bringing back the maximalism of what’s called “Showa retro' for residents and tourists alike

item.title: ₹7.36 trillion question: Can India store enough power to keep the lights on?
item.description: The Central Electricity Authority estimates that India will need ₹7.36 trillion to develop 122.77GW of pumped storage capacity over 87 projects. This investment is crucial for achieving 500GW of non-fossil fuel power by 2030 and enhancing grid stability as renewable energy sources grow.

item.title: Mundhe flags 2,841% markup on hospital consumables, seeks NPPA review
item.description: Mundhe's foray into hospital pricing follows an aggressive run at Mumbai's food sector earlier this year, when his inspections led to the temporary shutdown of several well-known eateries over hygiene violations.

item.title: India, South American bloc Mercosur announce plan to expand trade pact
item.description: The move comes as India seeks to diversify export markets and deepen trade ties amid global economic turmoil.

item.title: 'Cannot by themselves...': Why Delhi HC dismissed Vimal Elaichi makers' plea against notice to Shah Rukh Khan, others
item.description: Delhi High Court dismissed the Vimal Elaichi maker’s plea challenging show-cause notices to brand ambassadors Shah Rukh Khan, Ajay Devgn and Tiger Shroff. The court said Maharashtra courts have territorial jurisdiction, as the notices concern alleged violations in the state.

item.title: Prince Harry, Meghan Markle may take legal recourse to challenge 'private citizens' description by King Charles: Report
item.description: The couple has reportedly objected to language used in a letter authorised by King Charles, 77, which reaffirmed the arrangements surrounding their withdrawal from royal duties in 2020.

item.title: BRICS Summit: Delhi cop suspended after flaunting gun, sniper rifle videos on Instagram
item.description: The footage sparked a debate on social media, with users questioning why such videos were recorded and shared while Bangar was assigned to a sensitive security operation.

item.title: Brent nears $110 a barrel as West Asia conflict deepens, Hormuz talks delayed
item.description: Crude prices rose significantly after postponed talks between Iran and Gulf states, amid escalating tensions from Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities.

item.title: Kharif sowing gap narrows, but key crops lag
item.description: Overall kharif acreage is nearly on par with last year, but rice, maize, oilseeds, sugarcane and cotton continue to trail

item.title: Partition in UK? Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland push for exit from United Kingdom, ‘Europe is our common home’
item.description: Leaders from Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland met to promote joint independence efforts. They seek a fairer economy, collaboration on renewable energy, and stronger ties with the EU.

item.title: Western Australia steps up India push with critical minerals, trade in focus
item.description: Premier Roger Cook’s trade mission will seek deeper ties in critical minerals, energy transition, aviation, education and tourism, as the Australian state looks to expand business opportunities in India.

item.title: Reservoir levels recover, but water storage remains below normal
item.description: Recent monsoon rains have pushed up storage above normal in western, central and eastern regions, but overall levels remain below normal ahead of the rabi season.

item.title: US pilot reveals how he survived 50 hours with a broken back in Iranian mountains after being shot down by enemy forces
item.description: Bravo's ordeal became even more dangerous when his parachute failed to deploy properly. He fell towards the ground at an estimated 70 to 100 miles per hour before landing in a mountainous desert region.

item.title: DRI seizes 362 tonnes of Pakistan-origin dates routed via UAE
item.description: Under 'Operation Deep Manifest', officials intercepted 13 containers at Nashik, exposing a UAE transshipment network used to bypass India's total ban on Pakistani goods.
